The '''''Burning Gear''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that served in the [[Burning Gear (flotilla)|Burning Gear]] [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]], a part of the [[Ebruchi (fleet)|Ebruchi]], the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Ebruchi|eponymous]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The ship was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the Ebruchi [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ness (pirate)|Ness]] and was equipped with [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Burning Gear'' was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
